decisions.decision: Auto-creation on-request — processRecurring() called in ExpenseController::index() before fetching results
decisions.rationale: No background scheduler needed; works on Vercel Hobby plan

decisions.decision: One entry per template per trigger — avoids flooding expense list after long absence
decisions.rationale: User gets most recent missed period only, not full backfill

decisions.decision: Deduplication via last_created_date on recurring template
decisions.rationale: Simple, no extra table needed — create entry only if today > next_due(last_created_date + frequency)

decisions.decision: Three frequencies: daily, weekly, monthly (ENUM in DB)
decisions.rationale: Covers v2 scope; no end date — template active until deleted

decisions.decision: RecurringPage uses table layout + inline form (no separate route) — mirrors BudgetPage pattern
